decisions.description: Determines whether the account ID passed into the flow resolves to an accessible Account record. If GetInputAccount returned no row (record-not-found or insufficient sharing access), the flow exits silently -- equivalent to AccountResolutionResult.invalidAccount in AccountResolutionService. Otherwise control passes to WhichAccountType for kind classification.
decisions.name: IsInputAccountValid
decisions.label: Is Input Account Valid?

decisions.description: Determines whether the input Account's RecordType is registered as a household type in the FSC FinServ__GroupRecordTypeMapper__mdt custom-metadata type. When a mapping row was returned by GetFscHouseholdRecordTypeMapping, the account is treated as a household and control passes to GetAccountContactRelationshipPrimHshldMbr. Otherwise the flow exits silently (matches the BUSINESS default in AccountResolutionService.resolve, package-world branch).
decisions.name: IsHouseholdAccount
decisions.label: Is Household Account?

Flow.description: Gets the details of a household account or a person account record and sends those details to the associated prompt template as prompt instructions.

recordLookups.description: Gets the active, primary account contact relationship record with an Account ID matching the ID of the account record passed into the flow as part of the prompt template input. Stores the result in the Account Contact Relationship from GetAccountContactRelationshipPrimHshldMbr record variable.
recordLookups.name: GetAccountContactRelationshipPrimHshldMbr
recordLookups.label: Get Account Contact Relationship

recordLookups.description: Gets the account record with an ID that matches TargetAccountId. Stores the result in the Account from GetAccount record variable.
recordLookups.name: GetAccount
recordLookups.label: Get Account

recordLookups.description: Gets the financial goal records with a primary owner ID that matches TargetAccountId. Stores the results in the Financial Goals from GetFinancialGoals record collection.
recordLookups.name: GetFinancialGoals
recordLookups.label: Get Financial Goals

recordLookups.description: Gets the active financial account role records with a related account ID that matches TargetAccountId. Stores the results in the Financial Account Roles from GetFinancialAccountRoles record collection.
recordLookups.name: GetFinancialAccountRoles
recordLookups.label: Get Financial Account Roles

recordLookups.description: Gets the 3 most recent person life event records with a Contact ID that matches the contact ID of the account record passed into the flow as part of prompt template input. Stores the results in the Person Life Events from GetPersonLifeEvents record collection.
recordLookups.name: GetPersonLifeEvents
recordLookups.label: Get Person Life Events

recordLookups.description: Gets open case records with an account ID that matches TargetAccountId. Stores the results in the Cases from GetCases record collection.
recordLookups.name: GetCases
recordLookups.label: Get Cases

recordLookups.description: Gets the most recent modified event record with an account ID that matches TargetAccountId and a subject of Meeting or Call. Stores the result in the Event from GetEvent record variable.
recordLookups.name: GetEvent
recordLookups.label: Get Event

recordLookups.description: Verifies that the account ID passed into the flow resolves to an accessible Account record. Mirrors the "Account row lookup" guard in AccountResolutionService.resolve: if no row is returned (record missing or sharing-restricted), the downstream IsInputAccountValid decision terminates the flow -- equivalent to AccountResolutionResult.invalidAccount. Stores the result in the Account from GetInputAccount record variable.
recordLookups.name: GetInputAccount
recordLookups.label: Get Input Account

recordLookups.description: Gets the Account RecordType row that matches the input Account's RecordTypeId. The resolved DeveloperName is later joined against FinServ__GroupRecordTypeMapper__mdt to determine whether the record type is registered as an FSC household type. Returns null if the input Account has no RecordTypeId or the RecordType is inaccessible -- in either case the downstream IsHouseholdAccount decision will treat the account as non-household, matching AccountResolutionService.isFscHouseholdRecordType.
recordLookups.name: GetInputAccountRecordType
recordLookups.label: Get Input Account Record Type

recordLookups.description: Gets the first FinServ__GroupRecordTypeMapper__mdt row whose FinServ__AccountRecordType__c (DeveloperName of the Account RecordType registered as a household type) matches the input Account's RecordType DeveloperName. Package-world equivalent of AccountResolutionService.isFscHouseholdRecordType. If a row is returned, the input Account is a household; if none is returned, the IsHouseholdAccount decision terminates the flow.
recordLookups.name: GetFscHouseholdRecordTypeMapping
recordLookups.label: Get FSC Household Record Type Mapping

variables.description: Stores the account ID of the primary household member if the account record passed into the flow as part of prompt template input is a household record. If the account record passed into the flow as part of prompt template input is a person account, it stores the ID of the person account.
variables.name: TargetAccountId
